summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) under the shared venv. Deviation: added a BNode guard before graph lookups so None and plain strings cannot act as wildcards. Not verified: mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore placement and black formatting were checked by reading only. Nothing was committed.
